What is Попутный ветер?

In this glossary, Попутный ветер refers to: The flight path parallel to the landing runway in the opposite direction of landing.

How is Попутный ветер used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Башня инструктирует: 'Входите в попутный ветер на полосу 09, доложите при прохождении башни.'"

Definition

The flight path parallel to the landing runway in the opposite direction of landing.

Operational example

Tower instructs: 'Enter downwind runway 09, report abeam the tower.'

Localized term
